title: Middle powerhouse: A new blueprint for British internationalism – European Council on Foreign Relations
gist: Anthony Dworkin argues that Britain under new PM Andy Burnham (with foreign secretary Ed Miliband) must abandon its 'steward of the rules-based order' posture and become an innovator in flexible coalitions, organised in three concentric circles: the EU and anxious US allies, middle/emerging powers, and reformed multilateral bodies. Key levers are economic-security cooperation with the EU, Britain's niches (climate, AI chips/security, finance) and its 2027 G20 presidency, all framed to win back a sceptical domestic public amid Reform UK's rise.
